calculation_handling.description: If a lawfully existing ancillary building's lawful setback is less than the 150.8.60.20 minimum for a laneway suite building, the minimum rear yard setback for a laneway suite in that building is the existing building's rear yard setback.
calculation_handling.gaps: The value is the as-built rear setback of the existing ancillary building; existing() needs a date or enactment the text does not give, and we hold no as-built input, so no expression is written.

units.disclosure: A laneway suite created in an existing garage or shed may keep that building's existing rear setback; not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: If a lawfully existing ancillary building's lawful setback is less than the 150.8.60.20 minimum for a laneway suite building, the minimum side yard setback for a laneway suite in that building is the existing building's side yard setback.
calculation_handling.gaps: As-built side setback; no as-built input and no date for existing(), so no expression.

units.disclosure: A laneway suite created in an existing garage or shed may keep that building's existing side setback; not evaluated.

150.8.60.21(1).explanation: If you convert an existing, legally built garage or shed into a laneway suite and it is closer to the lot lines than laneway suite rules allow, its existing rear and side setbacks are accepted.
